description: This file contains the core definitions and utility functions for Ext JS Library 3.4.0, including version info, object extension methods, DOM manipulation, event handling, and animation utilities.

methods.name: Ext.apply
methods.description: Copies properties from source objects to a target object, optionally including a default object.

methods.name: Ext.extend
methods.description: Creates a new class that inherits from a superclass, with optional overrides.

methods.name: Ext.get
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element by id or element reference.

methods.name: Ext.fly
methods.description: Provides a lightweight wrapper for DOM elements for advanced manipulation.
